item.title: Kino 1.4
item.description:
• A new look. A sidebar takes you to Home, Library, Downloads, the Internet Archive and Settings, and every page flows from the artwork at the top into the rest.
  • Search pops up over whatever you're on: press ⌘F or ⌘K, or just start typing. It finds titles by name, original name, actor or genre, and the people in them.
  • New episodes: shows you're watching are checked every day. A Home row lists episodes from the last two weeks, and you get a notification when one comes out.
  • Seasons show episodes that haven't aired yet with their dates, and a movie page shows the rest of its collection, including the films you don't have.
  • Continue Watching suggests the next film of a series after you finish one.
  • Use your phone as a remote: scan the code from the phone button in the player to play, pause, skip, and change audio and subtitles.
  • The player has an Audio & Subtitles panel with subtitle timing, plus picture in picture (P).
  • Your Year: what you watched this year, with your top shows and genres.
  • Downloads and Settings are redesigned, and descriptions expand in place with More.

item.title: Kino 1.3.2
item.description:
• Movies with numbering in front of their name, like “1. Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone (2001)”, now get recognized.
  • When a title can't be found straight away, Kino tries simpler searches, and Fix Match does too, so fewer files end up unmatched.

item.title: Kino 1.3.1
item.description: • Timeline previews and Skip Intro now kick in as soon as a video you're watching finishes downloading, without reopening it.

item.title: Kino 1.3
item.description:
• Pause All and Resume All in Downloads, plus a field to paste a magnet link.
  • Download and upload speed limits in Settings → Storage.
  • A notification when a download finishes and is ready to watch offline.
  • Movie pages show how far a download has got, and their menu can pause or resume it.
  • A season's row shows which episodes you don't have, as empty slots between the ones you do.
  • Fix Match accepts an IMDb or TMDB link and marks the current match.
  • The audio menu can make the language you're listening to the one every video starts in.
  • Search is ready to type into straight away, and when nothing matches it points you to the Internet Archive or a torrent.
  • Setup lists only real TVs for AirPlay and lets you choose when unwatched downloads are deleted.
  • Re-opening a torrent you paused keeps it paused, and download banners show the movie's name instead of the file's.

item.title: Kino 1.2
item.description:
• After you open a torrent or magnet link, its movie or show page opens as soon as Kino knows what it is, ready to play while it downloads.
  • Movie pages and posters show what's downloading and what's already on your Mac; hover the icon next to a movie's formats for how far along it is.
  • Download Movie in a movie's menu saves it for watching offline, like Download Season.
  • When you're offline, titles that need internet fade out, so you can see what you can still watch.

item.title: Kino 1.1.5
item.description: • The audio menu shows each track's full name and title, such as "Ukrainian – DUB (Le Doyen)" or "English – Original (Atmos)", instead of only its language.

item.title: Kino 1.1.4
item.description: • The subtitle menu shows each track's full name, such as "Ukrainian – Forced" or "English – SDH", instead of only its language.

item.title: Kino 1.1.3
item.description:
• Subtitles built into a video now show up while it's still downloading, not only once the download finishes.
  • Cleaner subtitle track names: no more empty brackets or "Forced (Forced)".

item.title: Kino 1.1.2
item.description:
• Subtitle files in a Subs or Subtitles folder next to the video now show up in the player, and so do files like English.srt in a movie's own folder.
  • A title's page lists only the subtitle languages the player can show.

item.title: Kino 1.1.1
item.description:
• The screen no longer dims or turns off while a video plays on battery, including over AirPlay.
  • Converted Dolby audio keeps the film's full dynamic range, so quiet and loud scenes sound as in the original.

item.title: Kino 1.1
item.description:
• Kino now updates itself: Kino → Check for Updates…, and it checks once a day on its own.
  • Player keys (space, arrows, Esc and the rest) keep working after you open the episodes list or Up Next.
  • Delete a single season of a show, from the season title or the show's menu.
  • Shows that came from several downloads let you remove or download again each season separately.
  • Fewer wrong trailers: clips TMDB users attached from another show are left out.
